description: This file defines a Java class 'Properties' that provides reflection-based utilities to access properties of other classes, including handling of fields and getter methods, with support for transient annotations and exception handling.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Utility class for reflecting and accessing properties of Java classes, including nested classes for property representation and exception handling.

classes.name: PropertyAccessException
classes.description: Custom exception for errors accessing properties via reflection.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Abstract class representing a property with methods to get its name, type, and value.

classes.name: FieldProperty
classes.description: Implementation of Property for class fields, using reflection to access field values.

classes.name: MethodProperty
classes.description: Implementation of Property for getter methods, invoking methods via reflection to retrieve property values.

methods.name: findGetters
methods.description: Finds all getter methods in a class that are non-static, have no parameters, start with 'get', and are not transient.

methods.name: isTransient
methods.description: Checks if an annotated element has the Transient annotation.

methods.name: computeProperties
methods.description: Computes an array of Property objects representing all non-static, non-transient fields and getter methods of a class.
